meta.name: dnanexus-integration
meta.description: Build and operate reproducible genomics workloads on DNAnexus with the dx CLI, dxpy, apps/applets, native workflows, dxCompiler, and Nextflow. Use for DNAnexus data transfers, dxapp.json development, execution monitoring, workflow import, and project automation.

copy.tagline: 让基因组分析在云端标准化自动运行
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常批量跑测序分析,希望过程可复现且云端自动调度
copy.tagline_en: Automate reproducible genomics analyses in the cloud.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage many genomics analyses and need automated reproducible runs.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 dx CLI 和 dxpy 在 DNAnexus 平台上开发 app/applet、上传下载与搜索数据、运行并监控分析任务、搭建多步工作流。
howto.when: 当你要创建或修改 DNAnexus app/applet、管理数据对象(上传、下载、搜索),或运行与监控分析任务和工作流时使用。

say.text: 把 sample.fastq 上传到我的 DNAnexus 项目并跑一次比对
say.note: 会用 dxpy 上传并启动分析任务

say.text: 找出项目里所有 BAM 文件并下载到本地
say.note: 先搜索数据对象,再逐个下载

howto.what_en: Claude uses the dx CLI and dxpy to build DNAnexus apps/applets, upload or download data, run and monitor jobs, and assemble multi-step workflows.
howto.when_en: Use when you need to create or modify DNAnexus apps/applets, manage data objects (upload, download, search), or run and monitor analyses and workflows.

say_en.text: Upload sample.fastq to my DNAnexus project and run an alignment
say_en.note: Uploads via dxpy, then launches the job

say_en.text: Create an app skeleton with dx-app-wizard and write dxapp.json
say_en.note: Generates the skeleton and builds the app

say_en.text: Find all BAM files in the project and download them
say_en.note: Searches data objects, then downloads each
